thread:
Samira (partnerships): Locklayer Systems reached out — they want a Redwood marketplace tile + coordinated launch. Needs: SAML (IdP metadata exchange), SCIM group-scoped provisioning, KMIP/PKCS#11 HSM integration, and a Redwood secrets connector with auto-rotate support. They're proposing Aug 5 for public announcement. Anyone for a quick sync tomorrow? :wave:
Diego (product): I can join. We should agree on a single demo flow (console SSO -> provision user via SCIM -> secrets rotation using HSM-wrapped keys). Also need to lock embargo and PR owner.
Hannah (security): Requirements from our side: hardware attestation (audit report), FIPS/CC certs, proof that unwrapped private key export is disabled, and ability to sample wrap operation logs in staging. Also need SAML metadata to validate entityID/audience.
Locklayer Rep: Hi all ":hi:", yes we have FIPS 140-3 + attestation PDF. HSMs expose PKCS#11 and KMIP endpoints; we also offer a REST facade for cloud customers: https://api.locklayer.example.com/kms/v1/wrap. Timeline: staging by Jul 22, testing Jul 23-29, freeze Jul 31 for assets.
Ishaan (eng): For implementation we'll need: 1) sample PKCS#11/KMIP exchange, 2) short-lived test tenant + API key for DevX, 3) SCIM base and custom attrs, and 4) SAML metadata file (EntityDescriptor XML). Can you share those?
Locklayer Rep: Will upload SAML metadata (entityID: https://sso.locklayer.example.com/sp), SCIM base: https://scim.locklayer.example.com/v2, and a staging tenant with creds. We have a custom SCIM attr x:hw_slot for partition mapping.
DevX (devex): Please provide a SCIM test set (5 users + 2 groups) and a service account scoped to SCIM provisioning only. We'll generate automated tests and docs.
Samira (partnerships): Legal/marketing input? @LegalBot what embargo window do you want? We'll coordinate partner quote and webinar.
LegalBot: Draft MOU required; include clause: no unwrapped key export, partner to provide attestation, and consent to a one-time security review. Recommend 48-hour embargo post-asset signoff. Posting MOU template to shared drive now.
Diego (product): Proposed demo script (short): 1) Login via SAML SSO (Locklayer as SP) -> 2) Admin provisions user via SCIM -> 3) Console shows connector to Locklayer -> 4) Trigger a secrets rotation -> 5) Show KMS wrap call and that only wrapped bytes are returned. I'll draft steps and a short video script.
Hannah (security): Add to demo: show audit sample for a wrap op (timestamp, principal, key_id). We'll need partner to allow redaction if necessary but provide sample logs.
Ishaan (eng): Connector config sample (draft YAML) we'll test in staging:
```
connector:
  name: locklayer
  type: hsm
  endpoint: "https://api.locklayer.example.com"
  auth:
    type: token
    token: "<STAGING_TOKEN>"
  wrap_algorithms: ["RSA-OAEP-256","AES-KW"]
  scim_base: "https://scim.locklayer.example.com/v2"
  scim_custom_attrs: ["x:hw_slot"]
  auto_rotate: true
  rotation_window_days: 7
```
Ishaan (eng): Also planning a small kmip test script during QA, and a PKCS#11 smoke test for signing and wrapping.
Locklayer Rep: Confirmed: will upload attestation, SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, PKCS#11 snippets, and staging creds by EOD tomorrow. We can also provide KMIP test certs.
Samira (partnerships): Calendar hold: Fri Jul 21 9:00am PT for a 30m pre-QA sync. DevX/Legal/Product/Security please join. calendar-bot: meeting created.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: partnerships <> Locklayer pre-QA sync  Fri Jul 21 9:00am PT. Zoom link in invite.
DevX (devex): I'll prep SCIM test users and a runbook for the demo; also will need a short-lived HSM test key and sample wrapped payload to embed in docs.
Diego (product): I'll coordinate the blog outline + webinar host and pick a demo owner.
Hannah (security): I'll review attestation and schedule a brief 1:1 with Locklayer for technical questions prior to the sync.
Locklayer Rep: Looking forward to it. We'll drop everything into the shared folder and ping when done.
Samira (partnerships): Great work team. Post-sync we'll convert action items to a shared checklist and mark PR/marketing owners. :rocket:
